title: Setup QR payload (GET /api/setup-qr)
description: Scanned once by every phone at setup. Phones try 'servers' in order: local first, then the public tunnel if there is one.

sign_pk.description: Base64 Ed25519 public key that signs alerts, jobs and revocations.

box_pk.description: Base64 X25519 public key that reports are sealed to.

time.description: Server time (ISO 8601 UTC) so phones can correct their clocks.
